text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin invites me out for a
slightly late
New Year's shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming,
Trainer
<username>!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for inviting you out so suddenly,
but...
there's something that I need to
share with you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's always a Kiryuin family
gathering for
New Year's. It's mainly a
chance for us to
exchange the latest
information, but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This year, my great-aunt complimented
me for
the first time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: She said I've become a good mentor.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
My great-aunt has an important role in
the URA,
and she was once a skilled
trainer who brought
honor to the Kiryuin
family.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That's why... no matter how much the
people
around me say what a good job
I'm doing, my
family always tells me I
still have a lot to learn.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I was able to show them that I'm
worthy of
the family name, even if only a
little bit.
choice_data_list: 認めてもらえたんですね！

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...And that's because of you,
Trainer
<username>.
So
today, I'd like to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Your perspective has shown me
parts of
myself I couldn't see. With you
by my side, I've
been able to continue
improving.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so grateful to have you as my peer!
Let's
continue to push each other to be
the best
trainers that we can be!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It seems we've managed to get
each other
properly motivated for the
new year!

text_block_list.name: Male Barker
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! You seem like you've got
a lot of
spirit! Why don't you try putting
your strength to
the test?

text_block_list.name: Male Barker
text_block_list.text:
By participating in the New Year's Tile
Smashing
Extravaganza!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That sounds like another great
source of
motivation!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Thinking back, I used to have a real

fondness for karate!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sounds of smashing tiles and
Kiryuin's
vigorous shouts echo through
the January sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that my friendship with
Trainer
Kiryuin will continue to grow
from here.
